title: Unused import gleam/option in draft_integration_test.gleam
evidence: Line 10: `import gleam/option` — and `grep -n "option" server/test/integration/draft_integration_test.gleam` returns only that one line (the import itself); the module never references `option.` anywhere in its 572 lines.
detail: The only occurrence of 'option' in the file is the import, so the Gleam compiler emits an unused-import warning; sibling integration tests import gleam/option because they actually use it.

title: Hand-rolled list_length duplicates gleam/list's list.length
detail: The file re-implements the stdlib helper instead of importing gleam/list; six call sites (lines 178, 185, 206, 223, 227, 448) could use list.length directly.
recommended_fix: Add `import gleam/list`, replace `list_length` call sites with `list.length`, and delete the local helper.
